name: What are the benefits of adding insulation to my home's walls?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of adding insulation to my home's walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding insulation to your home's walls provides several key benefits. It significantly improves energy efficiency by reducing heat transfer, keeping your home warmer in winter and cooler in summer. This can lead to lower utility bills. Wall insulation also enhances indoor comfort by maintaining more consistent temperatures throughout your living spaces and can help reduce outside noise, creating a quieter environment. Additionally, new insulation can improve air quality by minimizing drafts and preventing moisture issues that could lead to mold growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wall insulation improves energy efficiency, reduces utility bills, enhances indoor comfort, and can help with noise reduction and air quality.
